notablePrerequisites:
Jund Battlemage does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Jund Battlemage.
description:
Activate Jund Battlemage's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {G}.
When the Saproling dies, Jund Battlemage triggers, untapping Jund Battlemage.
Repeat.
